يعتدين (form VIII)
# يَعْتَدِينَ (yaʕtadīna) /jaʕ.ta.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# يُعْتَدَيْنَ (yuʕtadayna) /juʕ.ta.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
